sloka: तां रक्षां जगृहुस्ताश्च मुनिहस्तात्समाहिताः ।अकुर्वंश्च ततो रक्षां तयोर्विगतकल्मषाः ।। ७.६६.१० ॥
transliteration: tāṁ rakṣāṁ jagṛhustāśca munihastātsamāhitāḥ ।akurvaṁśca tato rakṣāṁ tayorvigatakalmaṣāḥ ।। 7.66.10 ॥

translations.english: The attentive women took the protective charm from the sage's hands and, being purified, then performed the protective rites for the two newborns.
